events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks hard, and we're celebrating with some of her best.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th today! Get ready for some absolute anthems from the legendary Oasis frontman.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first James Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! We're celebrating the iconic spy with some of the greatest 007 theme tunes ever recorded.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius is undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles released Rubber Soul
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, Rubber Soul, on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped *Rubber Soul*. A true game-changer that showcased their evolving sound.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was assassinated on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, taken from us on this day in 1980. His message of peace and love lives on through his timeless music.
